paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to boost financial stability through short‑term products aligns with my experience building predictive models that drive credit decisions. I have designed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to support rapid, reliable risk assessment.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client. The prototype was showcased in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating end‑to‑end feasibility.
